verdict.rationale: Linear's changelog directly states that users can comment on text or images in issue descriptions, which matches the story exactly. The only evidence is a single changelog line, with no detailed documentation and no hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on inline-comment behavior (threading, resolving, anchoring), confirmation for other item types such as project descriptions or documents, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can comment directly on specific text or images within an item's description

citations.quote: You can now comment directly on text or images in issue descriptions.
